scope: Implement generic authored-DXF XDATA group and APPID registration preflight under existing PAR-19/7K without changing tolerant parsing or application-specific XDATA semantics.

changes: Validate that authored XDATA starts with a non-empty 1001 APPID marker and has no duplicate case-folded APPID sections per record.
Validate balanced group-1002 controls and the configured maximum application-group nesting depth.
Track APPID table rows emitted during streamed callbacks and reject unregistered XDATA applications before atomic publication; include mandatory ACAD.
Reject duplicate case-insensitive APPID table names.
Add source-authored ASCII/binary positive and negative tests, destination-sentinel checks, and same-codec retry after registration correction.
Register resolver test APPIDs explicitly and opt the raw tag scanner into retaining XDATA control strings only for the new focused wire assertion.
doesNotImplement: strict XDATA parser behavior or changes to tolerant raw replay
general 1005 target discovery or arbitrary reference-graph closure
native CAD or independent peer acceptance

covers: new structured XDATA validation in ASCII and binary DXF
existing XDATA reference-remap and ordered point-XDATA controls

readinessRefinement: Keep authored XDATA group preflight separate from tolerant parser/raw-preservation behavior.
Because APPID callbacks are streamed, verify required names against APPID rows actually emitted before transaction commit.
Retain focused generated ASCII/binary tests for nested controls, registration failures, destination preservation, and same-codec recovery.
Continue legacy MTEXT typed profiles, handle-graph closure, and consumer qualification as separate follow-up owners.
